title: Obj File
description:
That file object is looking MIGHTY suspicious. Let's check it out... --- ## Assignment: 1. Try to `cat` the file you used to find the previous lessons answer (cat will try to interpet the contents as text)... ```bash cat path/to/that/file/from/previously ``` No luck... The content is in raw bytes! 2. Try using `xxd` on it. XXD will print the binary contents in hex format! ```bash xxd path/to/that/file/from/previously ```
You may need to install XXD. If so:
APT (Ubuntu/Debian...):sudo apt install xxd
Pacman (Arch):sudo pacman -S vim

Yes, that's vim. XXD is bundled with vim on pacman.

Brew (Mac):

XXD should be preinstalled. If not install the full xcode bundle.

xcode-select --install
3. Do it again, but redirect it to a temp file for the tests. ```bash xxd path/to/that/file/from/previously > /tmp/commit_object_hex.txt ``` Run and Submit.
